overall_summary: View counts across all videos remain low (mostly under 50 views), indicating an early-stage channel. However, content focused on 'self respect' combined with everyday smartphone interaction metaphors (deleting chats, status lists, unpinning) consistently yields slightly better traction than purely passive sadness topics.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'rwOUYo_hayQ' (41 views), 'AfaLxMy6FMY' (41 views), and 'wFimeeP_aVc' (34 views) leverage active self-respect choices tied to phone usage.
winning_patterns.action: Continue focusing hooks on everyday digital cleanup actions tied to letting go.

weak_patterns.evidence: Topics like 'रात के ख्याल' and open-ended 'ओवरथिंकिंग' without a concrete action or object saw very low engagement (e.g., uIbMpCjVutQ with 6 views, WhJ-VwRa3Rg with 8 views).
weak_patterns.action: Reduce abstract late-night melancholy without a grounded physical or digital trigger.
